5_ssh_attempts.result: same: Web socket error: Unexpected server response: 400. Wrangler debug log shows the REST call GET /accounts/.../containers/instances/<id>/ssh returned 200 (session request accepted), but the follow-up WebSocket upgrade to the container itself was rejected with HTTP 400.

sequence_and_results.6_ssh_conclusion: The 400 is a websocket-upgrade rejection after a successful 200 session-request response, and it reproduced identically with the instance confirmed running (not idle) and with two different client invocations. This points to the container/network configuration (private network, no IPv4/IPv6 assignment, per wrangler.jsonc) or the account/tier not supporting the SSH debug feature for this container class, not a timing/readiness problem. No independent read-only filesystem surface was reachable for this container in either staging deployment.
